Combine the reusable-result cache with quality processing in one extraction configuration.

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', uri: 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf'), { 'enable_quality_processing' => true, 'use_cache' => true })
puts result.results[0].quality_score.inspect
```
